source: 5 AAC 33 (Southeastern Alaska Area), Article 3 - Salmon Fishery; content of the 2025-2028 Southeastern Alaska/Yakutat Areas Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations
citation: 5 AAC 33.350 (closed waters); 5 AAC 33.369-33.389 (terminal harvest area management plans)
notation: degrees and decimal minutes, e.g. "57° 16.28' N. lat." / "134° 48.00' W. long." - NOT degrees-minutes-seconds. lat_dm/lon_dm hold the value EXACTLY as printed, including source typos. lat/lon hold decimal degrees computed as degrees + minutes/60, negative for west longitude, and are null wherever the printed value falls outside the Southeast bounding box (lat 54-60, lon -138 to -130) - such values were never corrected or guessed.
source_document_caveat: The ADF&G PDF named in source_url could not be read past its Chapter 30 (Yakutat) material: the fetch relay truncates the document before 5 AAC 33 Article 3, and direct download of the PDF is blocked by network policy. All text here therefore comes from two independent Alaska Administrative Code mirrors, cross-checked against each other. The History note on 5 AAC 33.350 ends at 'am 7/28/2023, Register 247, October 2023', so the mirrors may not reflect any Board of Fisheries amendment adopted after that date. VERIFY AGAINST THE PRINTED REGULATION BEFORE RELYING ON ANY LINE FOR ENFORCEMENT OR FISHING DECISIONS.
verification_method: Every area was read twice, by two differently-worded fetches, and in most cases across two different hosts. Only values identical in both reads are recorded as verified_twice=true. Items marked verified_twice=false were reproduced by a single read and are flagged in their notes as provisional.

areas.text: The Kendrick Bay Terminal Harvest Area consists of the waters of Kendrick Bay west of 131º 59' W. long. and the waters of McLean Arm west of 131º 57.80' W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree, including that the Kendrick Bay longitude is printed as whole minutes (131º 59') with no decimal, unlike the McLean Arm value. Managed June 15 through September 30.

areas.name: Snettisham Hatchery special harvest area
areas.notes: NO numeric coordinates and NO named boundary landmarks are printed in this section - confirmed by fetch; the section refers to 'the special harvest area' without defining it geographically. Boundary must be obtained from another source.

areas.name: Carroll Inlet Terminal Harvest Area (Fishery A)
areas.text: the waters of Carroll Inlet north of the latitude of Nigelius Point at 55° 33.50' N. lat., 131° 21.14 W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree, including the missing prime on the longitude as printed. Note this is a different line from the standing Carroll Inlet closed water at 55° 24.27' N. lat. in 5 AAC 33.350(b)(4).

areas.name: Crawfish Inlet Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: waters east of a line from 56° 44.16' N. lat., 135° 15.80' W. long., to 56° 43.30' N. lat., 135° 17.81' W. long., to 56° 41.93' N. lat., 135° 17.54' W. long., to 56° 41.14' N. lat., 135° 13.80' W. long.; Cedar Pass south of 56° 47.14' N. lat.; Crawfish Inlet west of 135° 11.05' W. long.

points.name: Jamboree Bay
points.flag: named boundary vertex; no coordinate printed in the regulation

areas.notes: Agreed across Cornell LII and Justia (all six values). The section also names Jamboree Bay as a sub-area with no printed coordinate. The three clauses are joined here for transcription; consult the printed regulation for the exact clause order.

areas.name: Wrangell Narrows-Blind Slough Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: south of 56° 46.00' N. lat., and north and east of the northern tip of Woewodski Island at 56° 35.75' N. lat., 132° 59.35' W. long.; for Blind Slough the boundary is between Blind Point at 56° 38.84' N. lat., 132° 54.94' W. long., and Anchor Point at 56° 38.30' N. lat., 132° 55.67' W. long.
areas.notes: Agreed across two differently-worded fetches. Subsections (b), (c) and (h)(1) carry ADDITIONAL sport-fishing zone markers (56° 37.97' N./132° 53.47' W.; 56° 37.97' N./132° 53.63' W.; 56° 36.87' N./132° 49.40' W.; 56° 36.82' N./132° 49.40' W.) returned by only one fetch - NOT verified twice and deliberately excluded from the points list.

areas.name: Port Saint Nicholas Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: all waters of Port Saint Nicholas east of the longitude of Point Miraballes at 133º 05.23' W. long., and west of the longitude at 132º 59.50' W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree.

areas.name: Port Saint Nicholas THA - expanded troll area
areas.parent: Port Saint Nicholas Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: Cape Suspiro at 55º 27.48' N. lat., 133º 08.54' W long., to the northernmost tip of Toti Island at 55º 24.90' N. lat., 133º 07.34' W. long., to Point Miraballes at 55º 25.86' N. lat., 133º 05.23' W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree. The Point Miraballes longitude matches the value in subsection (b).

areas.name: Anita Bay Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: waters of Anita Bay south and west of a line from the tip of Anita Point at 56º 13.68' N. lat., 132º 22.48' W. long., to a point on the northern shore at 56º 14.26' N. lat., 132º 23.93' W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree.

areas.name: Anita Bay THA - subsection (b) closure lines
areas.notes: NOT VERIFIED TWICE - returned by one fetch only; the other Cornell read reproduced subsection (a) alone. Coordinates provisional; confirm against the printed regulation.

areas.name: Mist Cove Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: north of the latitude of 56° 28.00' N. lat., west of a line from 56° 28.00' N. lat., 134° 37.00' W. long. to Patterson Point Light to a point on the Baranof Island shore at 56° 32.52' N. lat., 134° 40.18' W. long. and east of the longitude of 134° 41.00' W. long. in Deep Cove.

points.name: Patterson Point Light
points.flag: named boundary vertex; no coordinate printed in the regulation

areas.notes: Both fetches agree. Patterson Point Light is a boundary vertex with NO printed coordinate.

areas.name: Mist Cove Special Harvest Area closure lines
areas.notes: NOT VERIFIED TWICE - returned by one fetch only; the first Cornell read reproduced subsection (a) alone. Coordinates provisional, and the connecting wording was not captured.

areas.name: Boat Harbor Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: waters within two nautical miles of the western shoreline of Lynn Canal from the latitude of Lance Point at 58º 43.95' N. lat. south to the latitude of a point located approximately 2.4 miles north of Point Whidbey at 58º 37.05' N. lat.; western boundary 135º 09.57' W. long.
areas.notes: All three values agreed across two independent fetches. The two hosts attribute the 135º 09.57' W. long. western boundary to different subsections ((a) per Cornell LII, (b)(1) per Justia); the VALUE is identical in both. Verify the subsection letter against the printed regulation. The section also cites stream number 115-10-10500, which is a stream catalogue number and NOT a coordinate.

areas.name: Southeast Cove Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: The Southeast Cove Terminal Harvest Area consists of the waters of Keku Strait enclosed by a line from a rocky point on the northern end of Kuiu Island located on the east side of Southeast Cove at 56° 52.95' N. lat., 134° 01.33' W. long. to the northwest corner of Hound Island at 56° 53.12' N. lat., 133° 56.77' W. long., then northwest connecting points along the northern shore of Keku Islands at 56° 53.98' N. lat., 133° 57.58' W. long. to 56° 54.90' N. lat., 133° 59.53' W. long. to 56° 55.93' N. lat., 134° 00.97' W. long. to 56° 55.95' N. lat., 134° 02.15' W. long. to 56° 55.22' N. lat., 134° 02.53' W. long. to 56° 56.37' N. lat., 134° 06.62' W. long., then to the northwest corner of Payne Island at 56° 57.45' N. lat., 134° 08.75' W. long., then south to a point on Kuiu Island at 56° 55.08' N. lat., 134° 09.25' W. long.
areas.notes: All ten vertices agreed across two differently-worded fetches.

areas.name: Port Asumcion Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: the waters of Port Asumcion north and west of a line from Point Cosinas at 55º 21.80' N. lat., 133º 30.64' W. long., to a point west of Point Maria located at 55º 22.04' N. lat., 133º 30.26' W. long.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree.

areas.name: Burnett Inlet Terminal Harvest Area
areas.text: waters of Burnett Inlet north of 56° 04.65' N. lat.
areas.notes: Both fetches agree that this is the only coordinate in the section and that no longitude is printed.
